entry_state: Chapter10 ends at243. Elimination requires matched transactions and unreused allocations;inventory markup follows the remaining lot. IAS29 restates purchasing power before IAS21 translation,with monetary exposure,first-application tax and comparative histories kept distinct. Exchangeability depends on direction,date and purpose;an observed rate does not establish the required estimate. Chapter11 starts at244. JPMorgan's disclosures distinguish parent,bank,issuer and guarantor,then parent earnings,cash,transfer capacity and consolidated restricted cash. Dividend declarations,capital-rule elections and eligible retained income have different clocks. The payout-restrictions subsection continues beyond246.
exit_state: The payout example distinguishes Part5 retained net income2m from Part3 eligible income10m;the lower applicable buffer ratio can make the table-based maximum zero. Systemic surcharge inputs require their own observation,publication and application dates. JPMorgan debt principal,carrying amounts,guarantees and contractual payment rights remain separate;reported succession does not prove repayment or derecognition. Loan creation can credit a deposit before external settlement. The simple EAD×PD×LGD example is explicitly limited;commitment amount,allowance,carrying value and expected funding are different populations. Section11.1.6 continues beyond252.

findings.observation: Distinct retained-income definitions and buffer tables produce a concrete zero-limit example. Systemic indicators preserve units,rounding dependence,observation years and reporting vintages;proposed rule changes are not treated as effective rules.

Debt disclosures separate an exact arithmetic match from an established legal/accounting relationship. The note's repeated2024 as-of date is not upgraded to2025. Default,notice,acceleration,remedy and succession remain distinct reported contractual events.

Loan creation and settlement are distinguished before introducing a deliberately restricted expected-loss formula. Actual commitment disclosures and historical amendment support retain scope limits;the enclosing subsection awaits its continuation.
